Mother of Murderer's Killer Set for Early Release

The mother of the killer of Henry Nowak is reportedly set for early release from prison. Police Chief, as reported by The Independent, stated that her release would be a 'significant blow' to Henry Nowak's family. Metro (UK) noted that the release could occur around the anniversary of Nowak's death.
